about: The Absalom Inheritance's sprite style sheet as data (WISHLIST.md B1). validate.mjs reads it; the sheet scripts read pad and their sheet. A frame is 112 + 2 * pad pixels wide (112 a square, render.js's largest tw on a 2x screen) and 56 + 2 * (ht + headroom) + 2 * pad tall, where ht is the solid's height in render.js pixels (SOLIDS by name, or the frame's own ht) and headroom is room above it for detail; its anchor is where the square's centre lands on the floor. fp is the footprint as a share of a square. faces names the PALETTE entry each face's centre must come out at, within faceTolerance levels; mask marks a frame rendered with red, green and blue for top, left and right, to be tinted at draw time. maxKiB is KiB x 1024, maxSide the longest side in pixels, maxTriangles the most any one frame's scene may hold, minCoverage the share of a frame's pixels at alpha 128 or more below which the frame is taken for empty or half-built, and boxSlack how far, as a share of the box, a frame's drawing may stand off the box it replaces.
